name: opencode-webui
description: Integrates the OpenCode web UI into a right-side panel of VS Code. Fork with fixed port, direct connection and Windows process detection.

opencode-webui.autoStart.markdownDescription:
Start the OpenCode server automatically when VS Code opens

VS Code 启动时自动启动 OpenCode 服务器

opencode-webui.hostname.markdownDescription:
Hostname for the OpenCode server

OpenCode 服务器的主机名

opencode-webui.hideButton.markdownDescription:
Hide the OpenCode button in the editor title bar

隐藏编辑器标题栏中的 OpenCode 按钮

opencode-webui.autoReconnect.markdownDescription:
Retry connection automatically when the server goes down

服务器断开时自动重试连接

opencode-webui.maxReconnectAttempts.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of reconnection attempts

最大重连次数

opencode-webui.sidebarPosition.markdownDescription:
Where the OpenCode view is shown: `left` = primary sidebar (activity bar), `right` = secondary sidebar.

OpenCode 视图显示位置：`left` = 主侧边栏（活动栏），`right` = 辅助侧边栏。

opencode-webui.devcontainerMode.markdownDescription:
Automatically detect opencode running in a devcontainer/remote environment

自动检测 devcontainer/远程环境中运行的 opencode

opencode-webui.autoInstallInDevcontainer.markdownDescription:
Automatically install opencode on activation in a devcontainer if not present

在 devcontainer 中激活时若未安装 opencode 则自动安装

opencode-webui.serverPort.markdownDescription:
Fixed port used when starting the OpenCode server (0 = random). Default 4096 matches opencode.json server.port, so browser settings like color scheme persist across restarts.

启动 OpenCode 服务器时使用的固定端口（0 = 随机）。默认 4096 与 opencode.json 的 server.port 一致，浏览器中的设置（如配色方案）可在重启后保留。

opencode-webui.connectExistingLocal.markdownDescription:
Detect and connect to an existing OpenCode server (default port 4096) even in a local (non-remote) environment

即使在本地（非远程）环境也检测并连接已有的 OpenCode 服务器（默认端口 4096）

opencode-webui.webuiSettingsBridge.markdownDescription:
Enable the settings bridge: always route the webview through the local proxy and inject a script into the WebUI page that listens for theme sync and 'open WebUI settings' requests. Disable to connect the webview directly to the server (no bridge features).

启用设置桥接：webview 始终通过本地代理路由，并向 WebUI 页面注入脚本以监听主题同步与「打开 WebUI 设置」请求。禁用后 webview 直接连接服务器（无桥接功能）。

opencode-webui.proxyPort.markdownDescription:
Fixed port for the local proxy injected between the webview and the OpenCode server. The proxy strips frame-blocking headers and injects a settings/theme bridge script. 0 = random port. Use a fixed port so the WebUI keeps its browser-stored settings (color scheme, theme) across restarts. Only used when the settings bridge is enabled.

webview 与 OpenCode 服务器之间的本地注入代理端口。代理会剥离阻止 iframe 嵌入的响应头，并注入设置/主题桥接脚本。0 = 随机端口。使用固定端口可使 WebUI 在重启后保留浏览器存储的设置（配色方案、主题）。仅在启用设置桥接时生效。

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
